pain_point: Home baristas finally dial in a perfect espresso shot but forget the exact grind size, dose, yield, temp, and timing by the next time they open that bean bag — wasting expensive coffee and restarting the dial-in from scratch
target_user: Specialty coffee enthusiasts and home baristas who rotate through multiple single-origin beans weekly and own adjustable grinders
visual_style: Craft Coffee Bag Label — kraft paper brown background with rubber-stamped typography, hand-lettered feel, stamp-circle roast badges, tan stitching borders. Warm, tactile, artisanal — like reading the back of a premium coffee bag.
tech_stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, served via nginx in Docker
